label: Local source cache record status policy

status_meanings.accepted_public_future: Future vocabulary only; not allowed for current runtime records.
status_meanings.candidate_source_record: A provisional source lead or source posture candidate requiring review.
status_meanings.deferred: Deferred for a later reviewed task.
status_meanings.future_live_probe_result: Future vocabulary only; live probes remain disabled.
status_meanings.needs_review: Review is required before downstream use.
status_meanings.policy_blocked: Blocked by source access, privacy, rights, risk, or product policy.
status_meanings.recorded_local: Recorded from explicit local fixture input only.
status_meanings.rejected_future: Future vocabulary only for a reviewed rejection trail.
status_meanings.risk_blocked: Future operational or privacy-risk block vocabulary.
status_meanings.source_observation: Repo-local source observation draft, not truth.

no_truth_claim_rules: No current status means public truth.
No current status means accepted evidence.
No current status allows master-index mutation.
notes: Current examples must not use accepted_public_future or future_live_probe_result.
